query: INSERT INTO flows (id, name, description, file_mask, is_default, definition, version, updated_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, datetime('now')) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name, description=excluded.description, file_mask=excluded.file_mask, is_default=excluded.is_default, definition=excluded.definition, version=excluded.version, updated_at=datetime('now') RETURNING id AS "id!: String", name, description, file_mask, is_default AS "is_default: bool", definition, version, created_at AS "created_at: DateTime<Utc>", updated_at AS "updated_at: DateTime<Utc>"
